timing_boundaries.scope: shared-environment latency on the same H800 and software
timing_boundaries.TX: fresh image encoding and communication encoding; digital serialization or all actual entropy fallback attempts, paid header, LDPC and modulation included
timing_boundaries.RX: actual received fields, header/body decoding and failure rule; independent entropy decoding where applicable; VAR completion and frozen Dc or the baseline decoder
timing_boundaries.software_e2e: audit-adjusted outer wall time minus separately measured channel-noise generation time
timing_boundaries.channel: software channel-noise generation; neither radio airtime nor propagation latency
timing_boundaries.audit: only named pure provenance hash costs explicitly measured and subtracted; original raw wall values retained
timing_boundaries.warmup: three fresh warmups followed by three fresh measured repeats per method/source/SNR; repeated wave/RX/output identities must match
timing_boundaries.units: CSV stores original seconds and derived milliseconds; manuscript table rounds milliseconds only

limitations: Shared resident workloads were present. These are shared-environment latency measurements, not uncontended latency.
Resource observations occur at case boundaries, not continuously inside each timed window.
Methods execute in a fixed sequential order; shared load and temporal drift can confound cross-method speed comparisons.
The three repetitions reuse the registered noise realization with fresh computation; they are timing repetitions, not independent quality-noise trials.
Qualification establishes within-run repeatability and source/model/code bindings; no new cross-host numerical-equivalence claim is made.
Software timing excludes model construction, disk persistence, evaluation networks and radio airtime. Energy consumption was not measured.
No same-hardware HiFi or BPG timing is supplied. No ratio to historical 4090D measurements is reported.
Parameter counts describe loaded components. P communication parameters alone are not the total system parameter count.
The worker receipt has no start tick; postprocessing conservatively requires its PID to be absent, even if that PID might have been reused.
